description: "Which companies won NASA SBIR Phase II awards for autonomy?" / "SBIR awards for [topic]" / "who received DoD SBIR funding" / "Phase I and Phase II awards at [agency]" — AWARDED federal Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and STTR grants: the small-business R&D contracts an agency has already funded. Search by keyword, agency ("DOD", "NASA", "DARPA", "NSF", "DOE", "HHS"), year, company, or state. Returns the winning company, award amount, agency and branch, topic code, abstract, fiscal year, and Phase (I/II/III), live from www.sbir.gov/awards (219,000+ awards, 1983-present). This is the tool for who WON federal small-business R&D money and how much; for opportunities still open to bid use sbir_search_solicitations.

agency.description: Filter by funding agency: DOD, HHS, NASA, NSF, DOE, USDA, EPA, DOC, ED, DOT, DHS, NIH, DARPA, ARMY, NAVY, USAF, and others sbir.gov itself lists. "DOW" is also accepted and translated to "DOD" — sbir.gov's own form still uses "DOD".

company.description: Filter by company name (substring match against sbir.gov's own company_name filter — a partial name like "Rydberg" matches "RYDBERG TECHNOLOGIES INC").

keyword.description: Search term to match against award titles and abstracts.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100). Award amounts and other detail-page fields are only fetched for the first 25 rows (a bounded number of extra HTTP calls); rows beyond that carry list-level fields only and `enriched: false`.

state.description: Filter by 2-letter US state code (e.g., "CA", "MA") — sent as sbir.gov's own state filter.

name: sbir_search_awards

phase.description: Funding phase (Phase I, Phase II, etc.)

title: Sbir Search Awards
